採用・広告の製品.quote: Shorten product development cycle from the earliest concept phase.
Product engineering cycle

Our software revolutionizes the design process by integrating advanced optimization techniques. With an implicit modeling engine, it generates and refines designs at unprecedented speeds. This ensures that your projects meet all production constraints while maximizing performance.
Achieve rapid design iterations for both structural components such as brackets and protective parts, without compromising on quality or reliability.
Our software allows you to create advanced production-ready parts for Molding, Machining, Casting, Additive Manufacturing and Forging.
Collaborate seamlessly with shareable, reusable processes
Share secure, reusable workflows that connect teams, streamline processes, and accelerate engineering performance.
Manage multidisciplinary design intents in one platform throughout the product development cycle

Thanks to Cognitive Design, we were able to rapidly design and validate a structurally optimized tank that fits within our CubeSat constraints, integrates all required functions, and meets demanding pressure requirements. It’s a game-changer for enabling component design exploration high-performance propulsion in small satellite platforms.
From concept to production, every decision is traceable, auditable, and connected, linking engineering insights and environments into one unified digital workflow.

Keep design objectives aligned across disciplines by centralizing requirements, decisions, and constraints in one environment. Maintain clear traceability and drive efficient collaboration from initial concept through final production.

Enable engineering teams to work seamlessly by sharing secure, reusable workflows that standardize processes, preserve expertise, and accelerate development. Facilitate efficient collaboration while safeguarding critical design optimization data.

Accelerate your engineering workflows with customizable, data-centric processes that enable you to explore, validate, and optimize high-performance parts faster. Integrate design, simulation, and manufacturing data to reduce development cycles.

Our next-generation geometric kernel leverages implicit modeling technology, enabling ultra-fast, robust modeling of complex, manufacturable geometries, overcoming the limitations of traditional boundary representations.

This is complemented by our advanced parametric workflows, manufacturing automation modules, and AI-driven multi-objective generative optimization, together creating a comprehensive, data-driven platform for high-performance, manufacturable product design
What training is required to use Cognitive Design effectively?

Engineers typically become productive within two days of training. The intuitive interface builds on familiar CAD concepts while structured courses cover optimisation setup, manufacturing constraints, and workflow automation.

Cognitive Design generates customisable reports including design summaries, comparison matrices, and performance charts. Reports export to standard formats for integration into technical documentation and project deliverables.

Engineers generate first optimised concepts within a few hours of defining requirements using Cognitive Design. Traditional approaches requiring manual CAD modelling and separate simulation take days or weeks to reach equivalent design maturity.

Cognitive Design offers flexible deployment including on-premise installation and private cloud options. On-premise deployment ensures complete data sovereignty, meeting security requirements of aerospace, defence, and regulated industries.

Weight reductions of 30-45% directly reduce material costs and improve product performance. In aerospace and automotive applications, lighter parts also reduce operational costs through improved fuel efficiency over product lifetime.
How does Cognitive Design impact project schedules?

Projects using Cognitive Design meet milestones more predictably by front-loading design exploration. Reduced iteration loops and earlier issue detection prevent schedule overruns that plague traditional development approaches.
How does on-premise deployment work for Cognitive Design?

On-premise deployment installs Cognitive Design entirely within customer infrastructure. All design data, optimisation results, and intellectual property remain on local servers with no external data transmission required.
Empowering smarter, faster product development.

We support leading Aerospace, Automotive, and Defense OEMs in navigating the shift from legacy tools to intelligent, AI-augmented processes. Our mission is to guide their transition to cognitive design, where decisions are faster, smarter, and always aligned with real-world constraints.

We provide a concurrent design platform where mechanical, CAE, manufacturing, and project teams work in sync. By breaking silos, we enable a faster development of manufacturable, high-performance products, more efficiently.

We embed intelligence into every step of the design process, from geometry creation to manufacturability analysis. This turns repetitive tasks into automated routines, giving engineers more time to innovate and explore high-impact solutions.
Enable Sustainable, Competitive Product Development

We help companies achieve operational excellence while addressing global challenges like decarbonization and electrification. Our goal is to enable faster design cycles, lighter products, and better use of resources, creating a clear competitive edge for our customers.

What manufacturing processes does Cognitive Design support?

Cognitive Design supports additive manufacturing, casting, injection modling,forging, and machining processes. Each process module applies specific design rules and constraints, ensuring generated geometries are manufacturable using the selected production method.

Cognitive Design embeds DFM principles throughout the design process. Real-time manufacturability feedback, process-specific optimisation, and automated constraint checking ensure designs are production-ready without costly late-stage modifications.

Manufacturing-driven design catches producibility issues during concept exploration, not after detailed design. This prevents costly rework that typically adds weeks to development schedules when problems surface during prototyping.

Cognitive Design provides relative cost estimates based on material volume, geometric complexity, and process-specific factors that engineer set up beforehand. Engineers compare manufacturing costs across design variants to identify economically optimal solutions early in development.

Engineers customise manufacturing constraints based on specific equipment capabilities and process parameters. Custom rules for minimum wall thickness, draft requirements, or feature sizes can be defined and saved for reuse across projects.

Engineers can define equipment-specific constraints reflecting actual production capabilities. Build envelope sizes, machine tolerances, and process parameters can be configured to match available manufacturing resources precisely.
